# NAPA, vendored

NAPA's C core, copied unchanged from https://github.com/zwatx/NAPA at commit
`de613adcd5a047e0f9345b7cfebcfd879cac8d98` (2026-11-01): `src/napa_vision/_native/napa_core.c`,
`napa_core.h`, `families.h` and `families/`, with its `LICENSE`, `NOTICE` and
`THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES`. `build.rs` compiles it with NAPA's own flags (`-O3 -std=c99 -fno-wrapv`).

To update, copy the same files from a newer commit and change the commit above.
